title: Super Moist Lemon and Blueberry Loaf Cake
excerpt: A very moist loaf cake thanks to Greek yogurt and olive oil, with fresh blueberries and a lemon glaze.
imageAlt: Freshly baked moist glazed lemon and fresh blueberry loaf cake

ingredients.text: 2 cups wheat flour (set aside 2 tablespoons for the blueberries)
Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar + 2–3 tablespoons lemon juice

steps: Beat the yogurt, oil and eggs. Add the sugar and the zest (only the green part, to avoid bitterness).
Sift the flour with the baking powder and salt. Coat the blueberries with the 2 reserved tablespoons of flour.
Combine the mixtures with a spatula, without overmixing so the gluten doesn’t develop. Add the blueberries.
Bake in a 20 x 10 cm (8 x 4 in) loaf pan at 180°C (350°F) for 55 minutes.
For the glaze, mix the powdered sugar with the lemon until smooth and thick. Pour it only when the cake is completely cold.
tips: If the cake browns too quickly, cover it with aluminum foil from minute 35.
It is even moister the next day: wrap it in plastic wrap once cold.
